title: West Bengal Postal Circle ships Rs 1 crore of Shola art abroad, up 50%
sum: The West Bengal Postal Circle shipped Shola artwork worth Rs 1 crore to the United States, Europe and Australia during Durga Puja, according to Chief Postmaster General Ashok Kumar. International shipments rose 50 per cent year on year. The circle also reported revenue above Rs 600 crore in the first six months of the financial year, up 30 per cent.
plain: No change to rates or service for shippers in the U.S. or elsewhere. The report concerns an Indian regional postal circle's export volumes, revenue and planned service expansions, with no stated tariff changes.

title: DroneXL adds 20 drone delivery town guides, covering 21 places in 16 states
sum: DroneXL published 20 new resident guides on its Drone Delivery Tracker on Oct. 12, 2026, one for each town or metro where Amazon Prime Air, Wing or Zipline is flying, has filed paperwork or has been named. With the Belvedere, California guide, the section covers 21 places in 16 states plus the Kansas side of Kansas City, and eight have a dated step before Nov. 10, such as a council vote, hearing or comment deadline. In its own commentary, DroneXL's Haye Kesteloo said towns decide more than most councils use.
plain: No change to rates or service. The guides track local votes, hearings and deadlines that bear on where drone delivery sites can operate.

title: FedEx adds duty and tax payment to Import Tool, expands to nine APAC markets
sum: FedEx said on Oct. 12, 2026 that it has added an integrated duty and tax payment function to its FedEx Import Tool and made the tool available in nine Asia Pacific markets. Importers can now handle document submission, clearance processing, status tracking and payment in one platform, the company said.
plain: Importers in nine Asia Pacific markets can pay duties and taxes and manage customs clearance steps in FedEx's online tool. The announcement states no change to rates or fees.

title: Orlando trucking owner pleads guilty in $1M USPS Freight Auction fraud
sum: Khayyam Arif Oglu Farajov, 40, owner of Talishco LLC in Orlando, pleaded guilty to one wire fraud count and one money laundering count, federal prosecutors announced Friday. DOJ said he falsely marked USPS Freight Auction shipments as delivered and collected more than $1 million. He agreed to forfeit two seized brokerage accounts and pay $993,979 in restitution, and the court has not scheduled sentencing.
plain: No change to USPS rates or service. The case concerns payments to a supplier in the USPS Freight Auction bulk-mail trucking program.
tie: DOJ announced the indictment in March 2026, and a 2024 federal audit of USPS Freight Auction proof-of-delivery controls covered the same period as the scheme.

title: USPS announces 2026 recommended holiday mailing and shipping dates
sum: The U.S. Postal Service announced recommended send-by dates for delivery before Dec. 25 during the 2026 holiday season. For the Lower 48 states, the dates are Dec. 17 for USPS Ground Advantage and First-Class Mail, Dec. 18 for Priority Mail and Dec. 19 for Priority Mail Express.
plain: No change to rates or fees. For delivery by Dec. 25, USPS recommends sending Ground Advantage and First-Class Mail by Dec. 17 in the Lower 48, and by Dec. 16 and Dec. 17 respectively to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and U.S. Territories. Priority Mail goes by Dec. 18 and Priority Mail Express by Dec. 19 in both regions.

title: OnTrac posts 2026 rate, AHS/LPS and area surcharge ZIP files on its rates page
sum: OnTrac's own Surcharges and rates page now lists four newly posted PDF files: 2026 rates, 2026 AHS and LPS rates, an area surcharge ZIP code list and a 2024 rates file.
plain: OnTrac's Surcharges and rates page now links four PDF documents that were not previously listed: a 2026 rates file, a 2026 file covering AHS and LPS rates, an area surcharge ZIP code list and a 2024 rates file. This was posted on the carrier's own page. The change shows only the file links, not their contents, so any price, surcharge or effective-date changes in the documents are not visible here. The 2024 file may be an archived guide rather than a new one.

title: DHL Group plans over EUR 400 million investment in Central and Eastern Europe through 2030
sum: DHL Group said it plans to invest more than EUR 400 million across Central and Eastern Europe through 2030. The program covers contract logistics, warehousing, B2B transport, control towers, international express and freight, and includes a planned DHL Express air terminal in Katowice, Poland.
plain: No change to rates or service is announced. DHL said the investment will add warehousing, transport and express capacity in the region through 2030.

title: India Post and Blue Dart sign parcel delivery agreement
sum: The Department of Posts and Blue Dart Express Limited signed an agreement to strengthen India's parcel delivery and logistics network, according to APAC Media. Blue Dart will use India Post's network of 1.64 lakh post offices to deliver parcels in urban, semi-urban, rural and remote areas.
plain: No rates, fees or effective dates were stated. The agreement is expected to extend Blue Dart's parcel delivery coverage, including prepaid and cash-on-delivery parcels, to remote and underserved areas of India.

title: Amazon seeks approval for about 1,000 daily drone deliveries from North Haven, CT
sum: Connecticut's Department of Energy and Environmental Protection is taking public comments on Amazon's plan for drone deliveries from its North Haven warehouse, CT News Junkie reported. Amazon seeks about 1,000 daily deliveries within 7.5 miles, and told lawmakers it expects deliveries to start in spring 2027. Comments are open until Oct. 15.
plain: No change to rates or service yet. If approved, Amazon would offer opt-in drone delivery within 30 minutes for packages of 5 pounds or less to addresses within 7.5 miles of the North Haven warehouse, with a stated start of spring 2027.

title: UPS to report Q3 earnings Oct. 27; analysts expect $1.63 per share
sum: UPS is expected to report fiscal third-quarter 2026 earnings before the market opens on Oct. 27, according to Barchart via Yahoo Finance. Analysts expect diluted EPS of $1.63, down 6.3% from $1.74 a year earlier. For the full year they expect $7.21, compared with $7.16 in fiscal 2025.
plain: No change to rates or service. The item previews earnings expectations and does not announce any price or service change for shippers.

title: USPS closes all Post Offices Oct. 12 for Columbus Day; delivery resumes Oct. 13
sum: The U.S. Postal Service will observe Columbus Day on Monday, October 12, and all Post Office locations will be closed, according to a Bossier Press-Tribune report. Regular mail delivery and retail services resume Tuesday, October 13.
plain: USPS Post Offices are closed and regular mail delivery and retail services are not offered on October 12; they resume October 13. Online services and self-service kiosks in select lobbies remain available, according to the report.

title: Telangana cyber bureau warns of parcel delivery fraud on World Post Day
sum: The Telangana Cyber Security Bureau (TGCSB) urged the public on October 9, World Post Day, to watch for parcel delivery frauds, fake delivery notifications and phishing links. It said criminals impersonate couriers or postal services and advised verifying parcel status through official websites or customer care channels.
plain: No change to rates or service. Recipients in Telangana are advised to verify delivery messages and avoid paying fees through links in unsolicited messages.

title: Stord closes $400M Citi-led credit facility, names CFO and CRO
sum: Stord said Thursday it closed a $400 million credit facility led by Citi, which it said was oversubscribed at nearly double its original target. The Atlanta-based fulfillment company also hired Bill Zerella as chief financial officer and Mark Wayland as chief revenue officer. Stord said the facility and its May $250 million Series F bring 2026 equity and credit capacity to $650 million.
plain: No change to rates or service. Stord said it will use the capital to expand its fulfillment network, deploy more robotics and invest in AI.
tie: The facility follows a $250 million Series F led by Strike Capital in May that valued Stord at $3 billion, according to the article.

title: USPS lengthens delivery standards for Priority Mail, Ground Advantage to and from Hawaii
sum: The U.S. Postal Service has released new delivery expectations for mail to and from Hawaii, according to Hawaii Public Radio. Priority Mail moves from two to three days to two to four days, and Ground Advantage moves from two to five days to at least 10 days.
plain: Shippers sending Priority Mail to or from Hawaii should expect two to four days instead of two to three. Ground Advantage packages are now expected to take at least 10 days instead of two to five. The source gives no effective date or rate change.

title: FCC to vote Oct. 29 on lifting 800 MHz cellular ban for drones
sum: The FCC will vote on October 29, 2026 on a draft order that exempts drones from the airborne ban in the 800 MHz Cellular band, Chairman Brendan Carr announced on October 7. The draft says the ban began as a 1984 policy and was codified in 1991 for airplane phones. If adopted, the rule takes effect 30 days after Federal Register publication.
plain: No change to shipper rates or service now. If adopted, drones could use the band for networked operations, including last-mile delivery, which the draft names among its use cases.
tie: The FCC first asked about dropping the ban in January 2023 and revisited it in the April 2026 public notice DA 26-314, according to DroneXL.

dates.w: FCC votes on draft order opening 800 MHz band to drones

title: NRF: US container import peak winding down, August likely busiest month
sum: The National Retail Federation's Global Port Tracker, produced with Hackett Associates, indicates August was likely the busiest month of 2026 for U.S. container imports, replacing September as the anticipated peak. Ports covered handled 2.3 million TEUs in August, up 0.4% from July and down 0.7% from August 2025. NRF forecasts full-year imports of 25.8 million TEUs, up 1.4% from 2025.
plain: No change to carrier rates or service. The report covers import container volumes, and NRF expects imports to ease through the rest of 2026.

title: UPS adds RFID tracking and PIN delivery for holiday peak, plans ~100,000 hires
sum: UPS entered the holiday season in early October 2026 with plans to hire about 100,000 seasonal workers and new services: RFID-powered tracking, Protected Delivery PIN verification for high-value parcels, expanded pickup visibility, Happy Returns returns, Roadie same-day and bulky delivery, and limited-edition holiday packaging. The Yahoo Finance analysis, which frames the news for investors, ties the additions to the UPS Secure Commerce suite launched in late September 2026.
plain: Shippers using UPS have access to new tracking, delivery-verification, returns and same-day or bulky delivery options for the holiday season. The article does not state any price or fee change.
tie: The services are bundled with the UPS Secure Commerce suite, which the article says launched in late September 2026 and combines InsureShield, Parcel Pro and CommerceShield.

title: Connecticut man gets 2 years for $3.5M Amazon Relay fraud scheme
sum: Ameer Nasir, 25, of Trumbull, Connecticut, was sentenced to 24 months in federal prison plus three years of supervised release, FreightWaves reported. Prosecutors linked 23 trucking accounts he registered with Amazon Logistics to more than 1,000 trailer movements that never occurred. The court ordered $3,547,090.93 in restitution, and he must report to prison Nov. 12.
plain: No change to rates or service. The case concerns past fraud on Amazon's Relay trucking platform, which ran from December 2019 through February 2021.

dates.w: Nasir must report to federal prison

title: Canada Post works to resume EU parcel shipping before holiday season
sum: Canada Post said it is working on solutions to resume personal and business shipping to the EU ahead of the Christmas season. It paused package delivery to nine EU countries, including France and Germany, on July 1 after the EU changed its customs and import VAT rules.
plain: Canada Post parcel delivery to nine EU countries remains suspended while the carrier seeks a compliant approach. Regular letter mail is not affected.

title: CBP starts processing IEEPA tariff refunds for finally liquidated entries
sum: U.S. Customs and Border Protection has begun processing some finally liquidated entries from plaintiffs the Court of International Trade ruled entitled to refunds of IEEPA tariffs, according to an Oct. 6 court filing. CBP has accepted 477 CAPE declarations covering 425,517 entries, and the capability is expected to handle roughly $11.4 billion, or 6.9%, of IEEPA tariffs.
plain: Importers that sued for refunds and submitted a valid importer of record number to CBP by July 30, 2026, can now apply through the CAPE portal for refunds on finally liquidated entries. Plaintiffs that submitted a number after July 30 must await further CBP instructions, with no timeframe given.
tie: CBP had targeted the end of July for this third phase of its CAPE rollout but delayed implementation until October, per Supply Chain Dive.

title: Amazon opens Bismarck delivery center to speed local deliveries
sum: Amazon held a ribbon-cutting at its Bismarck delivery center, which opened in August, according to The Bismarck Tribune. Site leader Charlyrae Nissen said the station is expected to cut delivery time in half by delivering directly from Amazon fulfillment centers instead of relying on the U.S. Postal Service for the last mile.
plain: No change to rates or fees. Amazon said shipments to Bismarck-area customers are expected to arrive sooner as the new station ramps up.

title: USPS to host job fairs in San Marcos and Valley Center on Oct. 16
sum: The U.S. Postal Service will hold job fairs at the San Marcos and Valley Center, California, Post Offices on Friday, Oct. 16, 2026, from 10 am to 1 pm. USPS said openings include Rural Carrier Associate and Assistant Rural Carrier positions at $21.89/hour and Holiday Clerk Assistant at $21.44/hour.
plain: No change to rates or service. The event is a local hiring effort for rural carrier and holiday clerk positions.

title: UPS routed F-35 parts through Hong Kong in error, Bloomberg reports
sum: UPS mistakenly routed sensitive components from Lockheed Martin's F-35 fighter through Hong Kong, Bloomberg News reported Wednesday, as summarized by Seeking Alpha. An employee failed to see a warning that the shipment was subject to U.S. arms-export restrictions, according to the report.
plain: No change to rates or service for shippers. The report concerns a routing error on a single restricted defense shipment.

title: Stripe and FedEx partner on financing for small businesses
sum: Stripe and FedEx said Tuesday in a joint press release that they will combine FedEx's data analytics unit, Dataworks, with Stripe's lending arm to create financing options for small and medium-sized businesses. The companies said they aim to expand access to financing for tens of thousands of such businesses. They said they aim to scale the offering into services by early next year.
plain: No change to FedEx shipping rates or service. The companies plan financing options for small businesses based on shipment and supply chain data, with services targeted by early next year.
tie: The partnership follows Stripe's purchase of embedded financing company Parafin, announced in a Sept. 30 news release, according to Payments Dive.

title: 24/7 Wall St. analysis questions UPS dividend coverage from free cash flow
sum: A 24/7 Wall St. analysis says UPS's $6.56 annualized dividend yields about 7.03% at $93.26 a share, and that 2025 dividends paid equaled 113.3% of operating cash flow minus capex. The piece cites management's July 28 call, where UPS said it still plans to pay around $5.4 billion in dividends in 2026, subject to Board approval. The outlet puts forecast free cash flow at approximately $5.5 billion.
plain: No change to rates or service. The piece is an outside view of UPS's dividend and cash flow, not a carrier announcement.

title: DoorDash adds Macy's, Anthropologie, Vans to retail Marketplace
sum: DoorDash said it is adding Macy's, Anthropologie, The North Face, Vans and Timberland to its U.S. retail Marketplace, with delivery in as little as an hour. DoorDash also plans a nationwide rollout in November of a return pickup service with a flat $7.99 fee, according to the Texarkana Gazette.
plain: Shoppers can order from the five brands through DoorDash with delivery in as little as an hour. DoorDash's return pickup service, now in a handful of U.S. markets, is slated to go nationwide in November at a flat $7.99.

title: Fake Amazon delivery texts are widespread, WXYZ Detroit reports
sum: WXYZ Detroit published a consumer report saying fake Amazon delivery text messages are everywhere. The piece covers how to spot them. The text provided contains only the headline, so no further details are available.
plain: No change to rates or service. The report is about spotting fake Amazon delivery texts.

title: 21vek.by operator Triovist launches own postal service after licence
sum: TOO Triovist, which operates the 21vek.by online hypermarket, received a postal licence from Belarus's Ministry of Communications and Informatization and launched the "21vek.by POST" parcel service, Наша Ніва reported, citing Office Life. The licence decision was made on June 15 and entered in the register on June 18. The report calls it the first postal licence the ministry has issued in four years.
plain: Senders in Belarus have a new parcel option from 21vek.by POST. Branch-to-branch rates for individuals start at 5.51 rubles for up to 1 kg, and door-to-door delivery starts at 22.90 rubles in Minsk and Minsk region.
tie: In September 2024, 21vek.by announced cooperation with Belposhta to expand its network of order pick-up points, according to the article.

title: NCRTC and Blue Dart to study parcel freight on Namo Bharat corridor
sum: The National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) and Blue Dart Express Limited signed an agreement to study moving e-commerce and other urban goods on the 82-kilometre Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut Namo Bharat corridor, according to Urban Acres, which cites a source report. The study will examine potential parcel quantities, station facilities and operational arrangements; it is not a confirmed parcel service.
plain: No change to rates or service for shippers now. The agreement starts a feasibility study, and the report gives no launch date, parcel tariff, station list or operating plan.

title: Evri Group agrees to acquire US cross-border firm Cross Border Connect
sum: Evri Group said it has agreed to acquire Cross Border Connect (CBC), a Boca Raton, Florida-based logistics enablement provider for delivery and returns. Financial terms were not disclosed. CBC CEO Chris Lentjes will continue to lead the business, according to the release.
plain: No change to rates or service has been announced. Evri said the deal is meant to support customers moving parcels between the UK, Europe and the US, particularly on the UK-US lane.
tie: The deal follows Evri's 2025 acquisition of Coll-8, whose customs clearance expertise Evri said combines with CBC's US capabilities.

title: C.H. Robinson to buy RXO in $5.8B stock-and-cash deal
sum: C.H. Robinson Worldwide plans to acquire brokerage and transportation services provider RXO in a stock-and-cash transaction valued at $5.8 billion, the companies announced Monday. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory clearance and RXO shareholder approval. The companies said the combination would create a third-party logistics company with over $25 billion in size.
plain: No change to rates or service has been announced. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory clearance and RXO shareholder approval.

title: Tracking Package explains why carriers change after customs clearance
sum: Tracking Package, a parcel tracking service, published a press release on The Manila Times describing why international shipments can show a new carrier, a new tracking number or a pause in scans after customs clearance. It says the international carrier typically hands the parcel to a national postal operator or regional courier for final delivery.
plain: No change to rates or service. The release describes how international tracking handoffs work, including a second tracking number that a domestic carrier may assign.

title: NLRB judge rules UPS safety vest policy barring union insignia broke labor law
sum: An NLRB administrative law judge, Kimberly Sorg-Graves, ruled in a Monday decision that United Parcel Service broke federal labor law by enforcing a work rule that kept employees from wearing union insignia on safety vests, according to Bloomberg Law. The judge found UPS did not show a legitimate business justification and rejected the company's safety argument.
plain: No change to rates or service. The ruling concerns UPS's workplace dress rule on union logos and buttons on safety vests.
